examples.name: Hsl colors
examples.body:
//using Actuation
val colors = 50
val color = rep(0)(c => (c + 1) % colors)
ledAll to hsl(color / colors.toDouble, 0.5, 0.5)

examples.name: Sensor based colors
complex shape
examples.body:
//using Actuation
val eyes = Seq(ledAll to "white", led(1,1) to off, led(1,3) to off)
val mouth = Seq(led(3,0) to off, led(3,4) to off, led(4,1) to off, led(4,2) to off, led(4,3) to off)
eyes ++ mouth
